sources.title: Lyria 3 Clip preview API specifications
sources.evidence: Exact identifier lyria-3-clip-preview: 30-second music clips; text/image input; MP3 audio and text lyrics output; 131,072 input tokens. Thinking and function calling explicitly unsupported. This page says 48 kHz.

sources.title: Gemini API release notes, March 25, 2026
sources.evidence: Explicitly launches lyria-3-clip-preview for 30-second clips on March 25, 2026, alongside the separate Pro variant.

sources.title: Lyria 3 model card, updated March 2026
sources.evidence: The card explicitly covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions. Architecture is latent diffusion over temporal audio latents; distribution is through hosted products and APIs. No total or active parameter count is disclosed. Read both HTML and linked PDF.

sources.title: Build with Lyria 3, our newest music generation model
sources.evidence: March 25, 2026 announcement identifies Lyria 3 Clip (lyria-3-clip-preview), its 30-second output and public Gemini API/AI Studio preview. Both Clip and Pro accept images and text; only Clip specifications are applied here.

sources.title: Gemini API Additional Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Governs Gemini API and AI Studio service access and prohibits extracting or replicating underlying models, including parameter weights. Supports proprietary hosted-service classification; documentation and code-sample licenses are not model licenses.

sources.title: Music generation guide
sources.evidence: Current guide still names lyria-3-clip-preview separately from Lyria 3.5 and specifies fixed 30-second Clip output with text/image inputs and audio plus lyrics. It says 44.1 kHz, conflicting with the exact API page and launch changelog wording.

sources.title: Lyria 3.5 model card, July 2026
sources.evidence: Later model card was checked for retrospective Lyria 3 specifications; it supplies no total or active count for Lyria 3 Clip. Its own architecture is not transferred to Clip.

sources.title: Google Cloud Lyria 3 model specifications
sources.evidence: Separate 3 Clip Preview section names the exact model ID, March 25 preview release, 30-second MP3 output, image-to-music and lyrics support, and 44.1 kHz audio. Hosted access is subject to Google Cloud preview terms.

sources.title: Gemini API model lifecycle
sources.evidence: Lyria table gives lyria-3-clip-preview a March 25, 2026 release and no announced shutdown date as inspected. This documents lifecycle status, not a successful inference test.

name.note: Official display name for the exact Clip preview API identifier.

developer.note: Published by Google; launch authors are from Google DeepMind.

release_date.note: Exact public API preview date. The February Lyria 3 app/model-card publication does not establish earlier availability of this API identifier.

open_weights.note: Hosted API/product release with proprietary access terms; no public checkpoint distribution is offered for this model.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification, not an SPDX claim or the license of documentation/code samples.

parameters_b.note: No total in the exact API documentation, original card/PDF or later 3.5 card. Targeted first-party research/report searches yielded no disclosed Clip count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count or defined per-step parameter accounting is published in the reviewed primary material; do not derive one from the diffusion label.

architecture.note: The card explicitly covers Lyria 3 and subsequent versions; the launch identifies Clip as a Lyria 3 variant. Temporal-audio latent diffusion is disclosed, while backbone details and dense/MoE classification are not.

context_window.note: Documented API input-token limit, not a generated-audio duration or a demonstrated conversational context. Third-party catalogs reporting 1,048,576 are not used over this exact first-party specification.

modalities.note: API-level modalities: text/image prompts produce music and textual lyrics. The core model card lists text input; the API explicitly adds image support. Do not transfer Gemini-app video input or cover-art output to this endpoint.

reasoning.note: The exact API capability table explicitly marks Thinking unsupported.

tool_call.note: The exact API capability table explicitly marks Function calling unsupported.

description.value: Google music-generation model that produces 30-second clips and lyrics from text or image prompts.
description.note: Describes the exact Clip endpoint without Pro song-length claims or promotional quality language; it is a music generator, not a general chat model.

patch.description: Google music-generation model that produces 30-second clips and lyrics from text or image prompts.

sources.label: Build with Lyria 3, our newest music generation model
Gemini API Additional Terms of Service

patch.notes: Lyria 3 uses latent diffusion over audio latents. Total and active parameters are undisclosed in the reviewed primary sources. The 131,072-token value is the API input limit; Clip output is fixed at 30 seconds. The exact API page says 48 kHz, while the current generation guide and Google Cloud specification say 44.1 kHz. The March 25 date is the public Clip API preview release.

summary: Verified all 14 fields; adds disclosed latent-diffusion architecture and proprietary license. Confirms March 25 API release, 131072 input-token limit, text/image input, lyrics/audio output, and explicit no-thinking/no-function-calling flags. Parameter totals remain undisclosed after primary card/PDF and later-card research. Records conflicting sample-rate specifications without asserting either.
